correctness.rationale: The four allowed-set sizes in inclusion–exclusion independently yield 4^nδ_0, -4(-1)^k3^z, the pair contribution 2^(n+1) only for one nonzero frequency type, and -4. Modular-eight arithmetic excludes one-type zeros for n>=4. The three odd-frequency counts give exactly (3^n-3)/4 extra zeros. Divisibility and explicit witnesses give exact gaps 8 and 16; translation-averaged range projection plus a negative odd-length kernel coefficient proves the endpoint threshold. A separate complete exact-integer Walsh-Hadamard enumeration tests every frequency for n=4..9, not the infinite claim.
